title: A shared process links these disorders

sentences.text: The route goes from SYT1-related disorders (Baker-Gordon syndrome) to STXBP1-related disorders through a shared process.
SYT1 and STXBP1 both act in the process that releases chemical messages from nerve cells.
Disease-related changes in both genes share at least one effect, and reviews group these genes in the same disease family.
This single link is marked supported, with curated database evidence and a confidence score of 0.7.
A route is only as strong as its weakest step; here, that is the shared-process link, so it is not certain.
